packed_lumas.unit: 8-bit native output pixel luma, Pillow RGB→L. Interpret the alpha byte as data.

ruling_method: At each of 35 different x positions from 270 through 1120 in 25 px steps, use the darkest original-paper pixel within ±10 vertical pixels of the marked baseline. Take the vertical 21 px median centered at that pixel minus its luma. Columns: x, marked_y, selected_y, paper_luma, median_neighborhood, drop. Stripes are intentionally estimated on the saved empty paper.
print_method: Inside each polygon following the angle of the Chinese or English school name, use the original paper only. Subtract each luma pixel from the local 21×21 median, retaining drops greater than 18. Printed character thickness, texture and focus differ from handwritten strokes.
writing_method: Use the same native output pixels in all three renders. Select the union of saved glyph layout bounding boxes; keep added writing whose v24 paper-minus-rendered luma drop is >18 and whose original-paper 21 px vertical median minus luma is <12. This excludes ruling cores. Report saved paper minus each rendered luma at those fixed samples. Higher positive drop means darker ink.
